Healthy Lab (مطعم المعمل الصحي) is a healthy restaurant in Al Ghubra Ash Shamaliyyah, Muscat. The menu runs to 90 dishes and drinks, from exotic salads, lean burgers and coconut-flour pizza to rice buckets, protein shakes and guilt-free sweets.
Almost every dish lists its calories, protein, fat and carbohydrates, and the protein and carb sources are sold by weight, so you can build a meal to your own numbers.
